messages:
mike: Heads-up — onboarding 42B-evo model into dev cluster. weights uploaded to s3://rdw-models/42b-evo/v1/ but the runtime loader is erroring on mmap. Anyone know if the canonical path prefix changed?

carla: @mike saw that. the upload team used 'weights/' instead of our expected 'model/'. loader expects either `<prefix>/model.bin` or `pytorch_model.bin`. can you paste `aws s3 ls` output?

mike: `aws s3 ls s3://rdw-models/42b-evo/v1/` -> shows `       0 2026-03-07 12:10:00 weights.bin`, `       0 2026-03-07 12:10:00 tokenizer.json`, `       0 2026-03-07 12:10:00 config.json`

jin: yep that's the mismatch. our fallback only checks `model.bin` and `pytorch_model.bin`. i can add a small shim in loader to accept `weights.bin` for now, but let's not deploy until we validate RoPE scaling params. did uploader set rotary scale to 0.5?

carla: checked config.json — it has "rope_scale": 0.5 and "rope_mode": "dynamic".

eli: small compatibility FYI: for MQA/GQA we must ensure `gqa_groups` in config aligns with kernel tiling. config currently has "gqa_groups": 64 which maps to 4-way MQA on A100. that will panic on certain GPUs (eg T4) if the kernel expects a different packing.

mike: ok. action items: (1) update uploader to write canonical `model.bin` symlink (2) patch loader to log a clear warning and accept `weights.bin` temporarily (3) validate rope/gqa params in onboard CI. @jin can you push the shim + warning?

jin: i'll open a tiny PR. also noticed tokenizer quirk: `tokenizer.json` uses legacy unk token `<unk>` but our inference path expects `<|unk|>`. i can add an adapter that maps legacy tokens to canonical ones during load.

apriltag-bot: deploy-check triggered: scale test on dev-gpu passed (1.2k tokens/s) but sliding-window unit test failing (off-by-one).

carla: sliding-window off-by-one often comes from KV cache index math when mixing large context + GQA. @eli can you take a look?

eli: on it. can you paste repro steps?

mike: repro: `pytest tests/runtime/test_sliding_window.py::test_large_ctx_gqa --run-slow` with env `MODEL=42b-evo`. failing assert at line ~218: expected 512 but got 511.

eli: found the bug — window stride calc used `floor((context - window) / stride)` instead of `ceil`. sending patch now and adding a fuzz test for odd-sized windows.

jin: PR #1872 opened with loader shim + tokenizer adapter + clear warning logs. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1872

carla: please add an onboard validator that enforces presence of `model.bin` (or a canonical symlink) and checks tokenizer canonical tokens during CI. we should reject uploads that don't include either.

mike: security note: ensure S3 bucket is private. i flagged perms to sec team.

elaine: sec confirmed the bucket policy is private, but there is an S3 lifecycle rule that auto-deletes incomplete multipart uploads after 7d — FYI for large uploads.

mike: thanks. i'll wait for PR merge then re-run canary and the sliding-window stress. tagging folks: @carla @jin @eli :thumbsup:
